title: Reuse configured feeds and lists with the same Kanbus interactions
description:
As a vertical app builder, I want boards, feeds, lists and filtered lists to share Kanbus data and interactions so domain behavior stays in application configuration.

Feature: Shared Kanbus views
  Scenario: Consistent configured views
    Given configured issue types, stage labels and the same issue collection
    When a host renders a board, feed, list and filtered list
    Then each view represents the same full issue identities and configured labels
    And selection and permitted edits use the same host-owned interaction contract
  Scenario: Domain configuration remains outside the shared implementation
    Given two hosts with different type and stage configurations
    When each renders the shared views
    Then each uses its own configuration without adding domain-specific tables or APIs
